source: Berkeley F25 L8 Sida Wang -- Predictable Noise / Adding Error Bars to Evals
method: seed-clustering design-effect audit (ICC + Kish DEFF + cluster bootstrap)
key_finding: Training-step metrics carry high within-seed autocorrelation: pooling S seeds x M steps as i.i.d. understates headline-CI width by up to 2.394x (DEFF=7.373, n_eff=6.78 vs n_pooled=50). Every TinkerRL-Bench headline must report SEED-CLUSTERED error bars; the papers that already aggregate per-seed then take seed-SE are correct, and this audit quantifies the trap for any pooled-CI reporting (closes row-07 H6 cluster-sensitivity thread).
